import sys


def main():
    seen = set()
    for line in sys.stdin:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        key = stripped.lower()
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            print(stripped)
    # The sorted loop is unnecessary and would break input order


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
